# PB08 TAXI (https://www.pb08taxi.com)

> 24/7 Premium, Verified Taxi and Cab Booking Service in Jalandhar, Punjab & North India.

## Overview
PB08 TAXI is a premier taxi and car rental service operating across Punjab, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, and Delhi NCR. We specialize in 24/7 airport transfers, one-way outstation drops, intercity corporate travel, and family pilgrimage packages.

## Key Service Routes
- **Jalandhar to Delhi IGI Airport (DEL Terminals 1, 2, 3) & Delhi NCR:** Direct one-way drops and round-trip transfers via NH44.
- **Jalandhar to Amritsar (ATQ Airport & Golden Temple):** Express highway transfers with zero wait times.
- **Jalandhar to Chandigarh (Shaheed Bhagat Singh Airport IXC & City):** Fast intercity travel.
- **Jalandhar to Ludhiana:** 45-minute intercity express transit.
- **Jalandhar to Hoshiarpur, Phagwara, Kapurthala & Nawanshahr:** Local city and rural Punjab pickups.
- **Punjab to Himachal Pradesh & Jammu:** Outstation tour packages to Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, Dalhousie, and Katra (Vaishno Devi).

## Fleet Options
1. **Compact Sedans:** Maruti Swift Dzire, Honda Amaze (Ideal for 1-4 passengers with luggage).
2. **Premium SUVs:** Toyota Innova Crysta, Maruti Ertiga, Kia Carens (Spacious seating for 6-7 passengers).
3. **Luxury Executive:** Toyota Fortuner, BMW, Audi (Executive travel & wedding VIP events).
4. **Group Travel:** 12 to 17-seater Tempo Travellers (Spacious AC pushback seats for large families).

## Guarantees & Features
- **Fixed Upfront Pricing:** Zero surge charges and zero return fees on one-way drop bookings.
- **100% Verified Drivers:** Police-verified chauffeurs trained for safe late-night and highway driving.
- **Instant WhatsApp Confirmation:** Direct one-click booking with real-time driver allocation and Google Maps pickup pin.
- **Doorstep GPS Navigation:** One-tap "Use Current Location" links real-time coordinates directly to chauffeur navigation.
- **Clean & AC Cabs:** Rigorously sanitized vehicles with dual air conditioning.
- **DPDP Act (2023) Compliant:** Customer privacy protected, opt-in promotional messages, and right to data erasure.
- **Service Hours:** 24 Hours a day, 7 Days a week, 365 Days a year.
